tools.description: Extract and validate structured expense data from receipt text or a provider-neutral receipt extraction. tools.name: get_receipt_example
tools.description: Free, fixed synthetic receipt request and expected human-review result. No user document is processed and no payment is authorized. Use this to evaluate Ardaro before any paid call.

tools.name: get_receipt_service_status
tools.description: Check receipt-service availability, configured USDC price/network, supported inputs, size limits, retention and exact-retry policy before authorizing a paid analyze_receipt call. Takes empty arguments {}; no receipt, credentials or payment metadata. Free and read-only: uses cached runtime readiness,

tools.name: match_invoice
tools.description: Compare one structured invoice and purchase order for human review. Check exact line references, quantities, unit prices and arithmetic; return source-linked discrepancies and explicit unknowns. No OCR, delivery verification, prior-invoice history, tax validation or financial posting. Paid: 0.50 USD

tools.name: get_invoice_matching_example
tools.description: Fixed synthetic request and result. Takes no arguments and accepts no payment or customer documents.

tools.name: get_invoice_matching_service_status
tools.description: Free cached readiness, price, supported inputs and recovery terms. Takes no arguments or payment. Readiness does not prove a payment settled.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_receipt_service_status" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
